in_progress.item: Switch natural gas provider — Lone Star Gas to Bluebonnet Energy
in_progress.note: Current plan is a variable rate that drifted to $1.87/therm; the new 12-month fixed rate is $0.94/therm with a $4.95 monthly customer charge and a $125 early-termination fee. Expected saving is the trailing-twelve-month usage at the two rates; it lands in confirmed once the first Bluebonnet bill posts.

steps.label: Compare fixed-rate offers
steps.detail: Pulled 12 months of usage from Lone Star Gas bills; Bluebonnet’s 12-month fixed beat the other two offers by about $9/mo.

steps.label: Enroll with Bluebonnet Energy
steps.detail: Enrolled online under Daniel’s name; no deposit and no credit inquiry beyond the standard check.

steps.label: Switch takes effect at the meter read
steps.detail: Bluebonnet confirmed the Nov 4 meter read as the handover date; Lone Star Gas sends a final bill for service through Nov 3.

steps.label: First Bluebonnet bill posts
steps.detail: Expect a partial first cycle (Nov 4 – Dec 1). Check the rate line reads $0.94/therm and the customer charge is $4.95.

steps.label: Verify the saving and move to confirmed
steps.detail: Compare the first full winter bill against the same month last year, weather-adjusted; if the run rate holds, this moves into the confirmed register.

steps.label: Shop the renewal before the term ends
steps.detail: Fixed term ends Nov 3, 2027; start comparing offers a month ahead so it does not roll onto Bluebonnet’s variable rate.
